title: The Best Smart Water Monitors
subtitle: Whole-home water flow monitors that catch leaks and track usage, ranked.
intro: We pulled the smart water monitors on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: leak detection, automatic shutoff, and plumbing-free installation.
systems_note: Every monitor here connects over Wi-Fi to its maker's app. YoLink's FlowSmart uses LoRa through a hub, so it isn't included here.

buyers_guide.a: A flow monitor watches your water use and spots leaks, dripping toilets, and running hoses. A shutoff valve can also close the main line. Some devices do both; others only alert you.
Strap-on meter readers clip around your water meter with no plumbing. Inline monitors and valves are cut into the main line and usually need a plumber.
Most run a nightly check for tiny steady flows, which catches running toilets and drips that a leak puck under the sink won't.
